key_information_units.information: Net profit decreased by 11% to €28.7 million; return on equity (ROE) declined to 12.9%; cost-to-income ratio increased to 52.3%.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Financial results table (page 16) and Managing Director's Statement (page 10)

key_information_units.information: Loan portfolio grew by 19% to €2.11 billion, driven by a 27% increase in business loans and a 17% increase in home loans.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Managing Director's Statement (page 10) and Financial results table (page 16)

key_information_units.information: Customer deposits increased by 9% to €2.05 billion, with demand deposits rising by 11% and term deposits by 8%.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Financial results table (page 16) and Managing Director's Statement (page 10)

key_information_units.information: Total customer base grew by 9% to 227,000 clients (including 19,000 new customers) over the year.

Strategic targets include increasing loan market share to 10% by 2030, doubling net profit to at least €60 million by 2030, achieving ROE of at least 15%, and maintaining a cost-to-income ratio below 45%.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Targets section (page 7) and Managing Director's Statement (page 10)

key_information_units.information: Secured €250 million in covered bonds and a €249 million European Investment Bank Group guarantee for new loans, while reducing reliance on more expensive term and foreign deposits.

Common Equity Tier 1 (CET1) ratio stands at 14.15%, Tier 1 capital ratio at 16.11%, and total capital ratio at 18.54%, meeting all regulatory requirements; designated as systemically important with an additional buffer requirement.

Implemented LEED Platinum-certified headquarters, paperless operations, IT equipment recycling, and financing of solar/wind parks (81.3 MW); secured European Investment Bank funding for gender equality and climate action projects.

Launched virtual card services, expanded branch network (including Valga and Viljandi), introduced a cashback program, and rolled out new loan products for small businesses and specific professions (e.g., Teacher's Home Loan, Home Defender Home Loan).
Distributed €7.2 million in dividends (25% of 2024 pre-tax profit) at €0.07 per share; proposed €6.7 million in dividends (0.065€ per share) from 2025 profit, taxed at 22/78 rate.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Dividend policy (page 24) and Proposal for profit allocation (page 134)

key_information_units.information: In February 2026, drew a €5 million subordinated loan from the European Energy Efficiency Fund (EEEF), classified as Tier 2 capital, to finance energy efficiency and renewable energy projects.
On 21 January 2026, Alvar Pihlapuu was appointed as a new Member of the Management Board.
